title: About
text:
Why Data Science
During my undergraduate studies, I was curious about how data can be used to understand problems and make better decisions. I joined the Master of Data Science program at UBC to build stronger technical and analytical skills and gain more hands-on experience working with real-world data.

title: About
text:
Outside of Data Science
Outside of university, I enjoy playing badminton, painting and drawing, and spending time outdoors. I also love wildlife and enjoy visiting new places whenever I get the chance. When I have some free time, you’ll probably find me watching a movie, vibing to songs, or sleeping!

title: Vikasini Senthilkumar
text: Hi! I’m Vikasini Senthilkumar. I grew up in Qatar and completed my bachelor’s degree in Computing Science at the University of Alberta. I am currently pursuing my Master of Data Science at UBC, where I hope to strengthen my skills in data science and machine learning. I’m excited to apply what I learn to real-world problems and continue building my career in the field.
